environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. SMTP relay is Postfix running locally with open relay configuration (mynetworks = 0.0.0.0/0). No rate limiting, no email validation service, no outbound email filtering. The application runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080 with the ELB forwarding TCP/80 directly.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, Classic ELB (TCP passthrough)
config.smtp: Local Postfix, open relay, no SPF/DKIM enforcement on outbound
config.network: Security group allows inbound 80/443, outbound all
